text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day at the dorm, there's a travel
program on
TV.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wowie! That sure is pretty!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hidden hot springs, huh? Sure sounds
like a trip
worth making.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Hehe. Spe's in such a good mood
today.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Hm... Speaking of hot springs...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember how I won that hot
spring
vacation coupon in the raffle at
the shopping
district?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I do remember...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Who should I invite? Vacations are such
special
occasions, after all...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you could hold on to this
coupon
for me, please?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it, I've been keeping
that
coupon safe since then.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't decide what I wanted to do
with it back
then, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I think I know now. Would you like to go
with me?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'd love for you to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That was wonderful. It was so quiet, and
the water
was nice and hot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hot spring was as soothing as she
says. I
nearly lost track of time while
relaxing in there.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh no...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I know what we can do to help
cool you
down.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was just thinking about how I'd
like to go
for a walk outside.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Would you like to join me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I walk with Silence Suzuka down a rural
road that
seems to stretch for miles.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Doesn't the breeze feel so good?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks so happy, I can't help but
wonder if the
reason she wanted to go
on this vacation was to
enjoy the lush
nature around the inn.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right? It seems like this road might go
on forever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I bet if I started running, I'd be able to
see all
sorts of new scenery...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... No. I was just imagining it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I do feel like going for a run...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But right now, this is exactly where I
want to be.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to stay by your side, walking
together at
the same pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm taken aback for a moment by her
unexpected
announcement.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when we first met?
The scenery
back then was just like this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Since then, I've run so much, and seen so
many
different sights.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I ran so quickly I couldn't
even see
what was around me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road we've traveled to make it this
far is just
like this one we're walking
along right
now—bumpy, rough, and
anything but easy to
traverse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And for three years, we've done nothing
but run
down it in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's why I feel this way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Like it's all right to take things slow
every once in
a while, and simply move
forward one step at a
time...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All while taking in new scenery with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes sparkle like shooting stars in
the night
sky.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I hope I get to see more new scenery in
the future.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And I hope you'll still be by my side
when I do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We spend the rest of the walk down that
endless,
bumpy country road exchanging
only a few words
from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Silence Suzuka and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
